summary.text: One of Penelope's suitors in Apollodorus' catalogue of the fifty-seven wooers from Dulichium — a namesake of Polyidus the seer of Ephyra who taught Glaucus the art of divination.

story.text: Apollodorus names Polyidus among the suitors who devoured Odysseus' substance, listed after Telmius and before Astylochus in the long company of Penelope's wooers.
